feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: After Democrats' midterm wins, some hope attacks on DEI will ease
entry.summary: After the midterms, a Democratic congressman declared that DEI is back. What does Democrats' ascendance portend for diversity initiatives that the Trump administration relentlessly attacked?

entry.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
entry.summary: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

entry.title: Trump administration proposes new tariffs on goods from major U.S. trading partners
entry.summary: President Trump's new proposed tariffs are already meeting pushback from Democrats and some free trade advocates.

entry.title: Sen. Tim Kaine, D-Va., shares why he opposes Trump's proposed tariffs
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Virginia Sen. Tim Kaine about the Democrat's opposition to President Trump's new tariffs.

entry.title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
entry.summary: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

entry.title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
entry.summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

entry.title: Group of Senate Democrats push to add freshman to leadership
entry.summary: Several Democratic senators have been signaling this move, saying the party needs to acknowledge the diverse class of incoming freshman that catapulted the party to victory in November.

entry.title: Republican wants FBI and CIA answers before questioning Nvidia chief
entry.summary: "The public is rightly concerned," says the Republican lawmaker, who wants to know what the FBI and CIA knew about potential national security threats and whether Jensen Huang was warned.

entry.title: Moving to Florida may become a choice of some Republicans after midterms
entry.summary: In Florida, Republicans kept power of state government after the midterms. It's now the largest state where the GOP is still in charge.

entry.title: The U.S. government is investigating Iranian ties to as many as 50 hacked commercial vessels
entry.summary: The attacks, if officials who spoke to NPR are correct, may be the latest example of Iranian cyberattacks against global critical infrastructure during the war with the U.S.
